sshCert.description: SSH-CA enrollment status for gateway host verification
sshCert.notEnrolled: Not yet enrolled with the SSH CA
sshCert.reenrollQueued: SSH-CA re-enrollment queued via the provisioning flow
sshCert.deleteWarning: If this device is SSH-CA enrolled, deleting it permanently revokes its host certificate (pki-manager offboard). This is irreversible: the certificate is dead, not dormant, and its (zone, FQDN) can never be re-registered.
sshCert.resetDescription: Use this after the gateway was REINSTALLED: its previous host key is gone, so the SSH CA refuses to re-enroll it (a re-enroll must be signed with the old key). Resetting lets the next enrollment be accepted as a first one, for the same host name. Nothing is revoked. If the old key may be compromised, delete and recreate the device instead.
sshCert.resetReasonPlaceholder: e.g. reinstalled from the live image
sshCert.resetDone: SSH enrollment reset — the gateway can enroll again (iotgw ssh refresh, or Enroll now)
sshCert.resetError: Failed to reset the SSH enrollment
